title: Understanding the Models
text: Model A includes height in inches and centimeters, and weight in pounds and kilograms. Model B includes only height in centimeters and weight in kilograms. Consider how these variables might affect the confidence intervals.

title: Confidence Intervals and Multicollinearity
text: Think about how multicollinearity might affect the confidence intervals of the parameters in Model A compared to Model B.

title: Effect of Multicollinearity
text: Multicollinearity can inflate the variance of the parameter estimates, leading to wider confidence intervals. This makes it more likely for the intervals to contain zero.
